mainEntity.name: How do I turn several photos into one PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add all the photos, put them in order and press Create PDF. Each photo becomes a page.
JPG photos are placed in the PDF without recompression. Other formats are converted at high quality.

mainEntity.name: Why was my phone photo sideways in other tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phones store rotation as a tag in the photo. This tool reads that tag and turns the page correctly.
